skill.name: set-up-magento-google-ads-enhanced-conversions
skill.description: Configure and troubleshoot Google Ads Enhanced Conversions for Magento and Adobe Commerce through Product Metrics. Check server-side tracking, consent settings, Google Ads customer data terms, and test order delivery.
skill.summary: Set up consent-based Google Ads conversion matching for Magento stores.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most matches are Markdown notation, ordinary vendor links, or authorized setup steps. The installation instructions introduce external package trust, and the workflow lacks safeguards for account changes, order lookups, and credential handling. No evidence of malware, prompt injection, or hidden data transfers was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: The installation instructions rely on external release sources.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer version and skill commit, verify module artifacts, and restrict the Composer repository to Product Metrics packages. Require developer approval before installing.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not require explicit approval for the vendor or account changes.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm Product Metrics, the store view, and the Google Ads account before authenticated access. Preview account changes and obtain approval before applying them.

remediation.issue: Order checks can retrieve unrelated production records.
remediation.suggestion: Use the specified test order and return only delivery status. If filtering is unavailable, use the app rather than listing production orders.

remediation.issue: The shared rules allow agents to collect credentials unrelated to this workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the credential exceptions from this skill. For other integrations, direct users to a provider-approved secret entry screen instead of chat or command arguments.

semantic_findings.title: No explicit approval gate for account changes
semantic_findings.description: The skill activates without a Product Metrics request and defines authenticated writes without first confirming the vendor, store view, and Google Ads account. A general request to fix tracking could be treated as approval to change connected accounts.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The rules reserve browser steps, bidding decisions, and deletions for the user, but do not require approval for other writes. No unauthorized write was observed.

semantic_findings.title: Test order checks can retrieve unrelated orders
semantic_findings.description: The suggested lookup lists recent storefront orders and retrieves details such as margin and customer status. Verifying delivery needs only the specific test order and its status.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented list is newest first and has no test order filter. Its company and storefront scope does not prevent unrelated order data from entering the assistant context.

semantic_findings.title: Credential handoff is not scoped to this integration
semantic_findings.description: The rules allow collecting Lightspeed, Meta, and OpenAI credentials and passing them directly to commands. They do not specify a protected input method, and these credentials are not required for Magento Enhanced Conversions in Google Ads.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exceptions and direct command handoff are explicit, despite the rule against logging. Exposure through tool transcripts or process arguments depends on how the agent passes the credentials.

content.user_title: Set Up Magento Enhanced Conversions for Google Ads
content.value_statement: Google Ads can miss Magento purchases when cookies alone cannot match orders to ad clicks. This skill guides you through consent-based matching and verifies test order delivery using Product Metrics.
actual_capabilities: Read Product Metrics setup status through its CLI or MCP connection and identify unfinished steps.
Check whether the Magento store view and existing Google Ads conversion actions are ready.
Guide consent setup for OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, Osano, or a custom banner.
Explain Google Ads customer data terms and interpret Data Manager readiness states.
Guide a test-mode order check for the linked property and explain what to check when an order is missing.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, an active Magento store view, and working server-side Google Ads tracking with Merchant Center connected.
A developer must install the Magento module and configure cron. A custom consent banner also needs developer support.
A Google Ads administrator must accept the customer data terms. The skill does not change primary conversion actions or bidding settings.
Test order delivery does not guarantee attribution or a higher match rate in Google Ads.

use_cases.title: Prepare an existing store for Enhanced Conversions
use_cases.description: Check which prerequisites are complete and identify the remaining steps before enabling customer data matching.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Google Ads readiness warning
use_cases.description: Distinguish missing customer data terms from a Data Manager delay or a disconnected Google Ads account.

use_cases.title: Validate consent and test order delivery
use_cases.description: Check custom banner integration, Magento cron, and test order delivery for one store view.

prompt_templates.title: List the prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need before setting up Google Ads Enhanced Conversions for Magento through Product Metrics? Use the guide only and make no account changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: plan the setup before connecting any accounts.

prompt_templates.title: Review consent settings
prompt_templates.prompt: My Magento store uses Cookiebot. Explain how to check the Product Metrics consent setting and what happens when a shopper declines ad user data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Guided setup: verify the selected banner before testing.

prompt_templates.title: Interpret a Data Manager rejection
prompt_templates.prompt: Product Metrics shows Data Manager acceptance as Rejected. Give me the steps to review the correct Google Ads account and re-check its status.
prompt_templates.scenario: Troubleshooting: resolve a Google Ads readiness warning.

prompt_templates.title: Trace a test order
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me verify delivery of one test order for my confirmed Magento store view and Google Ads account. Use only delivery status and do not list other orders. Check consent, cron, and revision status before proposing any changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: isolate a delivery problem without retrieving unrelated order data.

output_examples.input: Product Metrics says the customer data terms are not accepted. What should I do?
output: Open Tracking, then Google Ads in Product Metrics. Under Enhanced conversions, select Open Google Ads settings.
An administrator must review and accept the customer data terms in Google Ads. Use the manager account if Product Metrics identifies it as responsible.
Return to Product Metrics and select Re-check. Look for Ready under Enhanced conversions.

output_examples.input: My test order has not appeared for the connected Magento store view. What should I check?
output: Confirm the test order is paid and belongs to the store view linked to the intended Google Ads property.
Check that the configured consent banner matches the storefront banner. Ask your developer to verify Magento cron has run.
Under Manage Magento, check that the desired and active revisions match. Confirm order delivery before drawing conclusions about Google Ads attribution.

best_practices: Confirm the Product Metrics workspace, Magento store view, and Google Ads account before accessing or changing settings.
Use a test-mode paid order and verify only the details needed to confirm delivery.
Verify that the actual storefront banner records ad user data consent. Keep the Magento private configuration file outside chats and shared logs.
anti_patterns: Treating the Magento cookie restriction notice as consent to share customer data.
Pasting credentials or private module configuration files into an assistant conversation.
Making conversion actions primary or changing campaign bidding to test Enhanced Conversions.

faq.question: Do I need Product Metrics Pro?
faq.answer: Yes. This workflow requires Product Metrics Pro with Full Signal Tracking and existing server-side Google Ads tracking.

faq.question: Do I need a developer?
faq.answer: A developer installs the Magento module and sets up cron. A custom consent banner also needs developer integration.

faq.question: Do I need to change my Google tag?
faq.answer: No. Product Metrics sends the data with server-side conversion actions through Google Ads Data Manager.

faq.question: Can Google Ads match guest checkout orders?
faq.answer: Yes, when the guest email is available and ad user data consent is granted. Matching is not guaranteed.

faq.question: Is every customer field hashed?
faq.answer: Email, phone, and names are hashed. Google can receive country and postcode without hashing when the complete name and address field set is available.

faq.question: What if a shopper denies ad user data consent?
faq.answer: An order can still be sent without customer identifiers if ad storage consent is granted. With neither consent, the order is not sent.
